source: docs/rnd/2026-11-01-flyover-room-videos-proposal.md + the 2026-11-01 style research (studio reels, Israeli developer campaigns, tool preset catalogues); camera/lens numbers are archviz practice, not quotes

evening.relight_prompt: Relight this exact room for early evening: deep blue dusk sky through the glass, city lights beginning to glow outside, warm interior lighting on (ceiling spots, a floor lamp, a warm LED cove), soft warm reflections on the floor. Keep every wall, window, door and piece of furniture exactly where it is; change only the light and the sky.

delivery.disclaimer_he: התמונה להמחשה בלבד · הדמיה שנוצרה בסיוע AI

presets.when: west / sea-facing towers, terraces, penthouses; the broadest-appeal default
presets.time_of_day: 30-60 min before sunset, sun low over the Mediterranean
presets.sky: thin haze, a few warm cirrus

camera.approach: from over the sea toward the facade, slow rise then gentle push to the unit's floor
camera.facade: quarter orbit keeping the sun as rim light
camera.entry: through the terrace glass into the living room
camera.room: dolly toward the window, sun flares across the floor

presets.grade: medium contrast, saturation +10%, warm WB ~5000K, slightly lifted blacks; Kodak 2383 print family
presets.lifestyle: two glasses of white wine on the terrace, one person leaning on the rail, sheer curtains moving
presets.music: warm ambient / neo-classical piano and strings, 70-85 BPM
presets.text: thin geometric Hebrew sans, white lower-third, project name in English, developer logo bottom-right
presets.prompt_fragment: Photorealistic architectural film, Tel Aviv residential tower at golden hour, low warm sun over the Mediterranean, soft haze, long shadows, slow cinematic camera motion, warm Kodak film grade with lifted blacks, light oak floors and travertine catching sunlight, sheer linen curtains moving in a breeze, calm and aspirational, no people, smooth gimbal motion, 24 fps.

presets.when: the hero opening and the facade; dense urban towers where lit windows and the lobby sell
presets.sky: deep cobalt-to-indigo gradient, no stars, city lights on

camera.approach: street-level rise along the facade revealing the skyline
camera.facade: slow orbit with the lit lobby in frame
camera.entry: push through the double-height lobby or the terrace glass
camera.room: slow push; warm interior vs cool window

presets.grade: high contrast, cool shadows ~7000K with warm 2800K practicals, crisp blacks; teal-and-amber city night family
presets.lifestyle: a lit lobby with a doorman, one lit terrace with people
presets.music: cinematic electronic-orchestral hybrid, slow build, 60-75 BPM
presets.text: bold white Hebrew slogan over the sky, logo lockup at the end
presets.prompt_fragment: Cinematic blue hour, modern Tel Aviv high-rise, deep indigo sky gradient, warm interior lights glowing in the apartments, illuminated lobby in stone and bronze, slow camera rise revealing skyline and sea, high-contrast teal-and-amber grade with clean blacks, reflections on glass, gentle camera motion, photoreal, 24 fps.

presets.when: white / light-stone facades, sculptural buildings, seafront projects; architecture-forward developers
presets.sky: saturated clear blue, the sea deep turquoise

camera.approach: high aerial descending toward roof terraces
camera.facade: lateral glide revealing balcony shadow patterns
camera.room: pan from shaded interior to bright window, controlled exposure

presets.grade: editorial: saturation +15%, strong contrast, neutral-cool WB 5600K, crisp micro-contrast, blue/terracotta complement
presets.text: editorial magazine type, large and thin, English + Hebrew
presets.prompt_fragment: Bright Mediterranean noon, Tel Aviv seafront residential tower with a white facade and deep balcony shadows, saturated clear blue sky, turquoise sea, editorial architectural photography look, high contrast, vivid clean colours, slow lateral glide, crisp limestone and white plaster textures, photoreal, 24 fps.

presets.when: architect-led projects, interior-heavy clips, materials showcase; buyers who distrust glossy renders

camera.room: slow dolly, long holds on materials

presets.grade: low-medium contrast, saturation -15%, neutral-cool WB, soft highlight roll-off; Fuji Pro 400H muted filmic
presets.lifestyle: a book, a coffee, plants, a crumpled throw; imperfection welcome
presets.text: small and quiet, room names and sqm only
presets.prompt_fragment: Soft overcast daylight, muted painterly architectural visualization, desaturated natural palette, pale oak floor, limewash walls, grey travertine, linen sofa, matte black fixtures, slow steady dolly at waist height, low-contrast film look, calm lived-in atmosphere, no direct sunlight, photoreal, 24 fps.

presets.when: penthouses, branded residences, ultra-luxury, the sales-office screen
presets.sky: dark, city bokeh; optional wet street reflections

camera.room: dolly through a dark corridor into the lit living room with the city view

presets.grade: high contrast, crushed blacks, saturation -10%, warm practicals vs cool city, anamorphic flares, light grain; ARRI LogC to Rec709
presets.lifestyle: a whisky glass, a dressed table, a concierge
presets.music: cinematic strings / brass or slow electronic, 60-70 BPM, a swell at the reveal
presets.text: champagne thin type, English project name large, Hebrew small
presets.prompt_fragment: Dark cinematic luxury, night-time penthouse in a Tel Aviv tower, floor-to-ceiling windows with city-light bokeh, brass and walnut interior, fluted dark wood wall, marble island, deep shadows and soft practical lamps, slow anamorphic dolly, subtle lens flare, fine film grain, ARRI-style grade, elegant and exclusive, photoreal, 24 fps.

presets.when: family-oriented projects, kitchens and kids' rooms, urban renewal; social content

camera.entry: the door opens into the kitchen

presets.grade: natural contrast, saturation +5%, slightly warm 5200K, airy highlights; Portra 400
presets.lifestyle: breakfast on the island, coffee steam, a dog, kids' backpacks
presets.text: friendly rounded Hebrew sans, conversational captions, room labels
presets.prompt_fragment: Bright early-morning light streaming into an open-plan kitchen and living room, lived-in realism, breakfast details and coffee steam, light oak floor, white stone island, rattan chairs, plants, black-framed glass partition, natural gimbal motion, Portra-like warm natural grade, soft shadows, photoreal, 24 fps.

presets.when: 9:16 Instagram / TikTok teasers of 15-25 s, recut from any other preset
presets.time_of_day: inherits the parent preset (prefer golden hour or blue hour)

camera.approach: worm's-eye rise up the tower from the street
camera.room: fast push-ins, one human beat max, loopable end

presets.grade: parent preset +10% contrast and saturation, sharpened for small screens
presets.lifestyle: one strong human beat at most
presets.music: 110-125 BPM electronic or a licensed trend track, cuts on the beat
presets.text: big bold Hebrew captions centred in the safe zone, sound-off friendly, price / location callouts
presets.prompt_fragment: Vertical 9:16 cinematic reel, worm's-eye view rising up a glass residential tower in Tel Aviv, fast smooth push-in, macro close-up of travertine texture cutting to a wide terrace view of the sea, high-contrast punchy grade, golden hour, crisp and energetic but stable camera, loopable, photoreal, 30 fps.

presets.when: very early pre-sale when the developer will not commit to finishes; architect-facing decks
presets.grade: low saturation, paper texture, linework; or white model with outlines
palette: greenery and people as loose silhouettes
presets.prompt_fragment: Painterly architectural concept illustration of a residential tower, loose watercolor washes with fine ink linework, soft diffuse light, muted palette, visible paper texture, people as light silhouettes, gentle slow pan, non-photoreal, elegant, 24 fps.

presets.when: any project with a skinned 360 tour (the keyframes copy the panos; the video prompt must say the same look, never a generic one)
presets.sky: clear pale-blue morning sky with a little haze

camera.entry: the door opens into the kitchen

presets.grade: natural contrast, saturation +5%, slightly warm 5200K, airy highlights; Portra 400
presets.lifestyle: unstaged, no breakfast props, no people
presets.text: friendly rounded Hebrew sans, conversational captions, room labels
